title: SIMD
description:
Use the `xmm` registers to handle several values per instruction:

| Function | Result |
|---|---|
| `add_arrays(dest, a, b, n)` | dest[i] = a[i] + b[i] for n 8-byte numbers, n even: two at a time with `paddq` |
| `sum_pairs(array, n)` | the total of n 8-byte numbers, n even: two running totals in one xmm register, then a horizontal add |
| `brighten(pixels, n)` | adds 50 to each of n bytes **with saturation** (200 becomes 250, 230 becomes 255), n a multiple of 16: `paddusb` |

`brighten` needs 16 bytes of 50 to add: put them in your own data, `fifty: times 16 db 50`, and load them with `movdqu`.

starter.solution.asm:
add_arrays:
        ret

sum_pairs:
        xor     eax, eax
        ret

brighten:
        ret

solution.solution.asm:
section .rodata
fifty:  times 16 db 50

        section .text
add_arrays:
        xor     eax, eax                ; byte offset
        shl     rcx, 3                  ; n * 8: the bytes to do
.loop:  cmp     rax, rcx
        jae     .done
        movdqu  xmm0, [rsi + rax]
        movdqu  xmm1, [rdx + rax]
        paddq   xmm0, xmm1
        movdqu  [rdi + rax], xmm0
        add     rax, 16
        jmp     .loop
.done:  ret

sum_pairs:
        pxor    xmm0, xmm0
        lea     rdx, [rdi + rsi*8]
.loop:  cmp     rdi, rdx
        jae     .done
        movdqu  xmm1, [rdi]
        paddq   xmm0, xmm1
        add     rdi, 16
        jmp     .loop
.done:  pshufd  xmm1, xmm0, 0x4E        ; swap the 64-bit halves
        paddq   xmm0, xmm1
        movq    rax, xmm0
        ret

brighten:
        movdqu  xmm1, [rel fifty]
        lea     rdx, [rdi + rsi]
.loop:  cmp     rdi, rdx
        jae     .done
        movdqu  xmm0, [rdi]
        paddusb xmm0, xmm1
        movdqu  [rdi], xmm0
        add     rdi, 16
        jmp     .loop
.done:  ret

rules: Add two numbers at a time with paddq.
